metric: CER (eval/metrics.norm both sides, Levenshtein over reference characters) over all development lines, both views, errors summed over the arm's two seeds
decision: F_s4 (synth4) is better than D_s3v3 (synth3 v3) iff (1) on teacher_val the VN-cluster 95% interval of CER(F_s4) - CER(D_s3v3) (both views, errors summed over both seeds) lies entirely below 0 and CER(F_s4) - CER(D_s3v3) < 0 for each seed pair (same seed), and (2) on devnative v3 pooled (both views, both seeds) the VN-cluster 95% interval of the same difference does not lie entirely above 0. If (1) and (2) hold and the devnative interval also lies entirely below 0, synth4 is better on both cohorts. Otherwise synth4 is not measured better and synth3 version 3 stays the recommended VN-style synthetic data; the result is reported as no measured improvement.

strata.from: eval/synth3_ablation.py's strata (cohort metadata and references only), including rare-kanji (a kanji outside Jiten's 2,000 most frequent), plus three tags this protocol fixes, also from references only (eval/synth4_ablation.py tag)
strata.tail-kanji: the line holds a kanji with a curriculum deficit: fewer than K exposures in synth3 v3's 1,000,000 pinned crops (K = 80 for a class VN text uses, 25 otherwise)
strata.tail-any: the line holds any character with a curriculum deficit
strata.fl10-unk: the line holds a character outside FL10's vocab (read as <unk> by both arms)
strata.role: reported, VN-cluster intervals, no multiplicity control; they cannot change the decision

reported_not_decided: each devnative file separately (strict_ink, strict_grad, tv_native_ink, tv_native_grad) and every stratum
